definition: A line joining the swing highs and lows that differ by more than a minimum move, drawn over the last period bars.
boundaries: Its last segment moves as new bars arrive, so it repaints and no block computes it; confirmed swings are swing-high, swing-low and the fractal levels.
recognition: Used to read past swings and wave counts, not to trade the last leg.

sources.quote: The ZigZag indicator connects trend reversal points
